optimizedDescription.value: Indexes each workspace into one graph with unique file identities, SpecRepository specs, and exact cross-workspace resolution.

optimizedContext.value:
# Workspace Integration

## Rules
- File/Document identity: `{workspaceName}:{relativeToCodeRoot}` (e.g. `core:src/index.ts`). Project-global files via `graph.includePaths` outside any workspace: `root:{projectRelativePath}` (e.g. `root:docs/adr/0001.md`). `root` reserved. Physical file under workspace `codeRoot`: workspace identity wins; MUST NOT also persist `root:`.
- `path` canonical for `SymbolNode.filePath`, symbol ids, persisted relations. Also store `projectRelativePath` from project root of active `specd.yaml`: forward slashes, no leading `./`; outside root may contain `..`. Denormalize onto every extracted symbol. Workspace name = `SpecdWorkspaceConfig.name`.
- Parse MUST NOT treat Windows drive letter as workspace name. Match `^[A-Za-z]:[/\\]` or `^[A-Za-z]:$` = drive-letter path. Char before first `:` MUST NOT become `{workspaceName}`. Applies to exclusion, hotspot classification, SQLite workspace inclusion, package surfaces, CLI graph display. Workspace filter `C` MUST NOT match drive-letter path or bare `C:`.
- `SymbolNode.id` = `{filePath}:{kind}:{name}:{line}:{column}` (e.g. `core:src/index.ts:function:main:1:0`). `column` disambiguates same-line overloads.
- `SpecNode.workspace` (`string`) stores workspace (e.g. `core`, `_global`). Spec IDs `{workspace}:{specPath}` (e.g. `core:change`, `default:_global/architecture`), matching `SpecRepository`. Prefix from workspace `prefix` in `specd.yaml`.
- Discover from absolute `SpecdWorkspaceConfig.codeRoot`. `discoverFiles` workspace-agnostic: root in, root-relative paths out, plus `pathBase` so project-relative patterns match `pathBase` joined with path below root. Indexer derives `pathBase` as project root → `codeRoot`, prefixes workspace name.
- Resolve selectors by path relative to active `specd.yaml` project root. CLI/tool hosts MAY use `projectRelativePath` when input lacks `{workspace}:` prefix. Lookup adds to canonical identity; does not replace it.
- Exact graph file selectors normalize canonical workspace-relative, config/project-relative, and absolute paths to same file identity. Wildcard selectors preserve pattern semantics; MUST NOT coerce to one file.
- Workspace `graph` filters `allowedPaths`, `excludePaths`, `testPaths`, `ignorePaths`, `largeFilePaths`, `maxFileBytes` match owned files by `projectRelativePath` (`core:config` Requirement: Project-relative graph path semantics), not path below `codeRoot`.
- Candidate: `codeRoot` contains path. Owner: path passes that workspace discovery (`.gitignore`, global and workspace exclusions, `allowedPaths`). No rank by `codeRoot` depth or config order. Shared or nested `codeRoot` allowed when `excludePaths` and `allowedPaths` partition files.
- More than one owner: persist one identity per owner. Probable `specd.yaml` misconfiguration. Indexer reports workspace-overlap warning (`code-graph:indexer` Requirement: Workspace overlap diagnostic). Indexing MUST NOT fail.
- Specs only via workspace `SpecRepository`. No CLI precompute, callbacks, or filesystem fallback. Per spec: `repo.list()`; freshness `repo.persistedStateHash()` (formerly `specHash`); hash `repo.artifact()` contents from `spec.artifacts[].filename` excluding metadata/lock sidecars, `spec.md` first if present then remaining alphabetical by filename; `repo.metadata()` for `title` and `description` — `null` means `title` = `specId`, `description` = `''`, `dependsOn` = `[]`, no heading/section parse of `spec.md`; `repo.readPersistedDependsOn()`; coverage `repo.readPersistedImplementation()`.
- Pass 2 starts after `SymbolIndex` holds symbols from all workspaces and public bindings of every entry surface (barrel chains, other workspaces) are final. Relative imports stay same workspace (same path prefix).
- Package imports: `packageName → workspaceName` from each `LanguageAdapter` `packageResolution` facet (monorepo and multirepo). Resolve exported name only through target package published entry surface and public bindings of those entry files. Never search target workspace symbols.
- Qualified name declared as symbol identity (e.g. PHP class) resolves via exact qualified-name map in any workspace. Qualified name that only maps to a file resolves through importing adapter `qualifiedNameResolution` and `packageResolution` using prepared metadata.
- Resolved named package-specifier import: cross-workspace binding target, resolution step, file-level `IMPORTS` to entry file that published the name. Downstream `USES_TYPE`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS` use that binding as for relative import. Package import naming no symbol (e.g. Go package import) that resolves: file-level `IMPORTS` to entry files only.
- Unresolved package-specifier import: no relation, binding target, or step. Reason (adapter without facet, no entry surface, name not exported, or ambiguous) is non-persisted diagnostic. Package no workspace declares is external: no relation, counted only.
- Test files never package entries. Exact qualified-name lookup used by import MUST NOT resolve to a symbol declared in a test file.
- Cross-workspace identity is structured workspace, module/package, public-surface, symbol-space from configured code roots and `packageResolution` facts. Apply language case, visibility, supported package/project config. MUST NOT infer from global same-name match, same-name match inside target workspace, or name uniqueness.
- Workspace roots, package identities, `exports` or `main`, module paths, project references, autoload mappings, and other deterministic resolution inputs change derivation fingerprint and require reindexing. Those inputs are manifests from adapter `resolutionManifests()`.
- `ProjectGraphConfig` paths/patterns relative to project root: `includePaths?`, `excludePaths?`, `testPaths?`, `ignorePaths?`, `maxFileBytes?`, `largeFilePaths?`, `workspaces?: ReadonlyMap<string, { allowedPaths?, excludePaths?, testPaths?, ignorePaths?, maxFileBytes?, largeFilePaths?, respectGitignore? }>`.
- `IndexOptions`: `projectRoot: string`, `workspaces: readonly ProjectWorkspace[]`, `graphConfig: ProjectGraphConfig`, `onProgress?: IndexProgressCallback`, `chunkBytes?: number`, `vcsRef?: string`, `vcsRoot: string | null`. `specs` callback on `WorkspaceIndexTarget` REMOVED; indexer pulls `SpecRepository` from each `ProjectWorkspace`. CLI/MCP fills `ProjectGraphConfig` from `SpecdConfig.graph`.
- `IndexResult.workspaces`: `readonly WorkspaceIndexBreakdown[]` with `name`, `filesDiscovered`, `filesIndexed`, `filesSkipped`, `filesRemoved`, `specsDiscovered`, `specsIndexed`.
- `WorkspaceIndexTarget.respectGitignore` defaults `true`. `true` uses `vcsRoot` resolved upstream by `VcsAdapter.rootDir()`. Non-null `vcsRoot`: load `.gitignore` from VCS root, every directory between VCS root and `codeRoot`, then `codeRoot`, plus subdirectory `.gitignore` during walk. Rules relative to each `.gitignore` directory, including above `codeRoot`, matched against path below that directory. `.gitignore` exclusions absolute priority — `excludePaths` cannot re-include gitignored files. Negation cannot re-include a path whose parent directory is excluded, whichever `.gitignore` excluded it. `vcsRoot` `null`: do not load repository-root `.gitignore`; discovery MUST NOT probe `.git/`, `.hg/`, or `.svn/`. `false`: do not load `.gitignore`; only `excludePaths` exclude files.

## Constraints
- `@specd/code-graph` runtime-depends on `@specd/core` (types, domain services).
- Single `.specd/code-graph.lbug` for whole project.
- `discoverFiles` stays workspace-agnostic; indexer owns prefix, `pathBase`, `projectRelativePath`.
- Spec access only through `SpecRepository`; no filesystem fallback.
- File-identity metadata change (e.g. `configRelativePath` → `projectRelativePath`) makes existing stores incompatible; full rebuild after upgrade.
- Stores built under codeRoot-relative path-pattern semantics rebuild when discovery-fingerprint path-semantics marker differs.
